tasks.resolution: Added month_start_sessions, build_decision_schedule frequency month_open, AllocationConfig.cadence, CadenceSpec/resolve_cadence on ExperimentSpec, ablation/campaign wiring, wf_s1_cadence.json, and contract tests CAL-L/SCH-L/EXP-L/WF-L/ABL-L/SIM-L.
tasks.impact: Enables walk-forward CE gate for S1 vs S1+month_open under identical per-month KRW; operational S1 month-end lock unchanged until process_adopted_vs_baseline passes; cadence mutually exclusive with overlay/reserve/mapping/currency.

tasks.title: USD lot dust recycle into next integer VTI buy (S1 ledger fix)
tasks.why: S1 beat overlay/reserve/mapping/currency on CE; remaining compounding leak was integer-lot USD residue stored in cash_usd but never added to the next month's spend_usd before math.floor.
tasks.resolution: Added sim/lots.fill_integer_buys, wired run_allocation and run_baseline to spend prior cash_usd plus new conversion each month, and LOT-R-/SIM-I06-/BASE-I06- contract tests.
tasks.impact: Raises invested share count on the operational S1 path without changing PolicyId, monthly contribution, or CE experiment modules; idle USD drag bounded below one lot price per session.

tasks.title: Wave K: S1 FX defer walk-forward CE gate (friction path step 3)
tasks.why: S1 compounding lever after overlay/reserve failure is friction (mapping, costs, FX defer). conversion_fraction and CLI --fx-max-defer existed but ExperimentSpec and ablation/campaign hard-coded currency=None, blocking CE adoption for bounded KRW→USD defer under I5.
tasks.resolution: Added CurrencySpec and resolve_currency, ExperimentSpec.currency XOR overlay/reserve/mapping, candidate-only currency wiring in ablation/campaign, proxy rejection, currency_warmup feasibility and policy CLI preflight for currency/mapping, wf_s1_currency.json, and EXP-K-/ABL-K-/WF-K-/FEAS-K-/CLI-K- contract tests.
tasks.impact: Enables walk-forward and walk-forward-costs CE gate for S1 vs S1+FX defer under identical external cashflow; mapping and cost-grid paths remain separate experiments; operational S1 lock unchanged until process_adopted_vs_baseline passes.

tasks.title: Wave J: S1 ETF implementation mapping walk-forward (VTI vs ITOT)
tasks.why: Overlay and reserve CE gates failed; next.md lever is implementation choice. MappingConfig/apply_etf_mapping existed but ExperimentSpec and ablation/campaign hard-coded mapping=None, blocking S1 vs S1+mapping CE adoption.
tasks.resolution: Added MappingSpec and resolve_mapping, mapping_implementation_tickers, candidate-only mapping wiring in ablation/campaign, mapping feasibility (metadata + implementation marks), history_price_tickers union for ITOT, wf_s1_mapping.json, and EXP-J-/ABL-J-/WF-J-/VEH-J-/FEAS-J- contract tests.
tasks.impact: Enables walk-forward CE gate for bounded PIT ETF mapping vs pure VTI under identical cashflow; overlay/reserve/mapping remain mutually exclusive; operational S1 lock unchanged until process_adopted_vs_baseline passes.

tasks.title: Wave H: S1 explicit reserve ledger (I5-safe contribution schedule)
tasks.why: next.md Wave H requires varying invested KRW via an explicit reserve without new external cash; run_allocation only capped investable at monthly contribution with no labeled withhold/deploy bucket.
tasks.resolution: Added ReserveConfig/ReserveDecision/apply_reserve_schedule, AllocationConfig.reserve and snapshot reserve_krw with I6 NAV conservation, ReserveSpec/resolve_reserve and candidate-only ablation/campaign wiring, reserve_warmup feasibility, CLI --reserve-withhold-cap, wf_s1_reserve.json, and RSV-/EXP-H-/ABL-H-/WF-H-/CLI-H- contract tests.
tasks.impact: Enables walk-forward CE gate for S1 vs S1+bounded reserve under identical external cashflow; operational S1 lock unchanged until process_adopted_vs_baseline passes; overlay and reserve remain mutually exclusive.

tasks.title: Operator naming: canonical policy/overlay/experiment vocabulary
tasks.why: Operators read s1_us, modules, delta0, max_shift as research codes; JSON/CLI vocabulary obscured sleeve meaning and CE gate parameters without changing allocator math.
tasks.resolution: Added PolicyId/BaselineId.parse with POLICY_ALIASES and BASELINE_ALIASES; canonical strings (us, hurdle, extra_rules, max_tilt); Pydantic JSON alias keys; CLI --overlay-max-tilt/--hurdle/--extra-rules; rewrote configs/experiments/*.json; NAM-A contract tests.
tasks.impact: Shipped experiment JSON and CLI use plain-language tokens; legacy s1_us/delta0/max_shift still parse for backward compatibility.

tasks.title: Experiment window feasibility preflight (CPI PIT + overlay warmup)
tasks.why: Operators hit mid-campaign AllocationDataError/PolicyError when experiment.start predates CPI PIT visibility or catalog history is shorter than overlay drawdown_window (252); ingest start and evaluation start were conflated.
tasks.resolution: Added validation/feasibility.py with resolve_feasibility, require_feasibility, assert_experiment_feasible; wired CLI ablation/walk-forward/policy preflight before simulation; FEAS-A and CLI-FEAS contract tests.
tasks.impact: Fails fast with structured FeasibilityError before expensive walk-forward runs; preserves fail-closed runtime and never auto-clamps experiment JSON dates.

tasks.title: Wave G: S1 + Bounded Overlay Walk-Forward
tasks.why: S1 locked; next lever is risk buffering without sells. Overlay engine existed but ExperimentSpec JSON hard-coded overlay=None, so S1 vs S1+overlay could not be gated.
tasks.resolution: Added OverlaySpec and ExperimentSpec.overlay, resolve_overlay, candidate-only overlay wiring in ablation/campaign _arm_config, proxy rejection, wf_s1_overlay.json, and EXP/ABL/WF-G contract tests.
tasks.impact: Enables walk-forward CE gate for bounded overlay vs pure S1 under identical cashflow; operational S1 lock unchanged until process_adopted_vs_baseline passes.

tasks.impact: First orthogonal US structure test vs S1; operational lock stays S1 until wf_s1_s7 process CE passes.

tasks.title: Wave B: Cost-Grid Walk-Forward (Ideal→Stress)
